description: This file is a Node.js script that inspects browser dependencies and missing libraries for different browsers (chromium, firefox, webkit) by analyzing files in the Playwright registry directory, resolving missing system libraries, and mapping them to packages. It includes functions for executing system commands, parsing dependencies, and interactively resolving ambiguities.

methods.name: pickPackage
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate package for a given library from a list, filtering out debug, test, dev, and mesa packages, and matching based on library name prefix.

methods.name: findPackages
methods.description: Uses 'apt-file' to search for packages providing a specific library.

methods.name: fileDependencies
methods.description: Runs 'ldd' on a file to list its shared library dependencies.

methods.name: missingFileDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies to return only those that are missing (not found).

methods.name: lddAsync
methods.description: Executes 'ldd' with an adjusted LD_LIBRARY_PATH to list dependencies of a file asynchronously.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command with arguments and returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

methods.name: getDistributionName
methods.description: Reads '/etc/os-release' to determine the Linux distribution's pretty name.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as 'Month Day, Year'.
